Sam: Free to a good home — pair of museum passes (SFMOMA) 2x general admission, expire 2026-06-30. Also a small wooden desk bench (fits under standing desk). Free pickup in SF Soma. DM to claim! :raised_hands:
Lina: interested in the bench — what are the dimensions?
Sam: bench is ~30"x12" and 17" tall, solid oak. light scuffs but sturdy.
Jon: i’ll take the museum passes if they’re still available :heart_eyes:
Sam: Jon you’re first for the passes, will hold until 5pm unless someone DMs earlier.
Tanya: can you hold the bench for me? i get out of a meeting around 5:30 and could swing by.
Sam: sure Tanya, i can hold the bench until 6pm.
Ryan: if Tanya can't make it i can pick up after 6 and drop off in the Mission, happy to help.
Jay: any chance you'd swap the bench for my monitor arm (ergotron vesa) + a coffee?
Sam: appreciate the offer but i'm looking to clear space, not swap — bench is free.
Jon: screenshot transfer ok for the passes? or do you need to meet?
Sam: screenshot/transfer link works. i'll DM the code to you after this thread.
courier-bot: reminder — office pickup requires badge check at security; bring ID if you're not on guest list.
Lina: thanks for the heads up re: badge!
Tanya: confirmed — i'll come by at 5:40 and grab the bench.
Jon: DM received from Sam, thanks!
Sam: passes spoken for (Jon), bench spoken for (Tanya). thanks everyone :party_parrot:
Ryan: sweet, thanks for posting Sam.
Jay: thx! next time i’ll offer snacks with the swap haha
Sam: lol deal.
_meta: thread about giveaways/swap in random — short, informal Slack style with pickup logistics, holds, and quick claims
